svg.title: 12 Automatic and user-requested retry sequence
svg.text: Retry calculation · repeat the saved request, preserve its model, DataContract and Custom Configuration
Example failed request: regional input { DeathPenatly: 700 }, frozen DataContract AND Custom Configuration, selected regional rule 700 × 0.90.
AUTOMATIC RETRY · only for recoverable failures, within the saved attempt limit
loop [temporary failure and retry allowance remains]
Roll back output; record failed attempt and Retrying; consume retry allowance
Claim another attempt; reload the same saved input and plan
Continue below when the issue is permanent
or the automatic retry allowance is exhausted.
Record final Failed status, explanation and manual retry eligibility
USER-REQUESTED RETRY · when retry is allowed: same calculation, new attempt, same model and both configuration inputs
Check retry request replay, permission and current calculation state
Failed and eligible; original input 700, BOTH original documents and the frozen plan
A newer DataContract or Custom Configuration
Commit Waiting + new dispatch generation + bounded retry allowance + retry receipt
Claim a new attempt; reload original input 700 and frozen plan
Save complete Gold + Ready, or save failure/retry outcome; never publish partial output
Status and result reference, or failure reason
or updated failure and next action
Already successful → return saved result. Already active → keep existing attempt. Repeated retry command → no duplicate. Edited input or either changed configuration → NEW calculation.
